business_problem: IBM Software Support needed to keep thousands of globally distributed engineers focused on high-value technical issues while still handling hundreds of thousands of cases, log analyses, and repetitive follow-up tasks across a large software portfolio.
solution_summary: IBM Software Support built a layered support-automation architecture on watsonx technologies to deflect routine work, accelerate diagnostics, and orchestrate follow-up tasks. Ask SW Support uses retrieval-augmented generation with watsonx.ai and large language models to answer low-complexity cases from IBM documentation and technotes after a single client interaction. Analyze SW Support combines hybrid classification and LLM reasoning to inspect log-heavy cases and create anomalous windows that help engineers troubleshoot faster across the company’s most active products. Automate SW Support extends the workflow by using watsonx Orchestrate and watsonx.ai to handle repetitive steps such as case follow-ups, updates, closures, and cross-team collaboration. Together these components turn IBM’s support knowledge base and case telemetry into a digital labor system that routes simple issues to AI, compresses investigative work on complex cases, and frees specialists to focus on the problems where human expertise adds the most value.

solution_components.name: Ask SW Support
solution_components.role: Uses RAG and LLMs to answer low-complexity support questions from IBM technical content.

solution_components.name: Analyze SW Support
solution_components.role: Applies anomaly detection and LLM-assisted diagnostics to speed up troubleshooting on log-heavy cases.

solution_components.name: Automate SW Support
solution_components.role: Automates repetitive case management tasks such as follow-ups, updates, closures, and collaboration handoffs.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.ai
solution_components.role: Provides the generative AI studio and LLM capabilities behind the support workflows.

solution_components.name: watsonx Orchestrate
solution_components.role: Coordinates the cross-team and case-lifecycle automations used by support engineers.

data_flow: A client issue is matched against IBM documentation and technotes through Ask SW Support, tougher cases flow through Analyze SW Support for anomaly detection on logs and datasets, and Automate SW Support uses watsonx Orchestrate to push updates, follow-ups, and closures back through the support workflow so engineers focus on exceptions.
business_outcome: IBM Software Support reduced repetitive effort, accelerated diagnostic work, and created large projected time savings across routine, complex, and follow-up support activities, helping engineers deliver faster and more consistent support experiences.
